label: Oral cavity cancer (head and neck)
note: Configurable by the clinical team. Required records derived from the NCG work-up for oral cancer (NCG Guidelines for Head and Neck Cancer 2019, quoted with page on every record). NCG lists the oral cancer work-up without Essential / Optimal / Optional letters (letters appear only for the imaging modality, neck ultrasound, chest X-ray and PET-CT / CECT thorax), so the listed records are treated as Essential. Squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity; HPV / p16 testing is an NCG item for oropharynx only. To be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use).
settings_note: NCG setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). Item 4.1 derives the required records per setting from the NCG tiers.

records.tier_basis: Listed in the oral cancer work-up without a letter: Essential in locally advanced and metastatic disease; Optimal in early disease, where NCG says imaging may not be warranted when the lesion can be evaluated clinically (neck ultrasound Optional there). MRI (tongue) or CECT (other sites) is NCG's Optimal modality, so any listed study of the face or neck counts (clinical review)
